name: Genesee County, NY
findings: Genesee County has 191 nonprofit organizations. 105 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 95 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Genesee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Genesee County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Genesee County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 95 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 education organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
